fusions.name: Gnawing Shaft
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Darkening Sky
fusions.desc: Looses a dense cloud of arrows 5 tiles ahead that deals 26 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 8% per affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Arrow Swarm
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that stings an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
